description: B's personal self-hosted Mem0 backbone — the single memory store shared by Claude Code and Hal. Does BOTH explicit hard facts (mcp__mem0__* tools) and passive auto-capture/recall (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Read/Stop/PreCompact hooks), partitioned by app_id (evergreen / general / hal-ops). Bundles the grill-me skill (Mem0-backed plan/design interview). Store identity is per-install — managed (local Qdrant + MCP server under launchd, no Docker), compose (this plugin builds and runs the stack from its vendored server), or external (somebody else runs the server) — and the whole configuration lives in one file, ~/.config/mem0-brady/.env. /mem0-brady:migrate moves memories between stacks. Run /mem0-brady:setup once.
name: mem0-brady
